name: logging
description: Server event logs: message deletes/edits, joins, leaves, bans, unbans, nickname and role changes.
short: Server event logging for moderation, messages, and member actions.

configFields.label: Default Log Channel
configFields.description: Fallback channel for log types without their own channel below. Empty disables logging.

configFields.label: Message Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for message deletes and edits. Falls back to the default log channel.

configFields.label: Member Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for joins, leaves, bans, unbans, nickname and role changes. Falls back to the default log channel.

configFields.label: Message Deletes
configFields.description: Log deleted messages.

configFields.label: Message Deletes Channel
configFields.description: Override for deleted messages. Empty uses the Message Events channel.

configFields.label: Message Edits
configFields.description: Log edited messages (before/after).

configFields.label: Message Edits Channel
configFields.description: Override for edited messages. Empty uses the Message Events channel.

configFields.label: Member Joins
configFields.description: Log members joining the server.

configFields.label: Member Joins Channel
configFields.description: Override for member joins. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Member Leaves
configFields.description: Log members leaving the server.

configFields.label: Member Leaves Channel
configFields.description: Override for member leaves. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Member Bans
configFields.description: Log bans.

configFields.label: Member Bans Channel
configFields.description: Override for bans. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Member Unbans
configFields.description: Log unbans.

configFields.label: Member Unbans Channel
configFields.description: Override for unbans. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Nickname Changes
configFields.description: Log nickname changes.

configFields.label: Nickname Changes Channel
configFields.description: Override for nickname changes. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Role Changes
configFields.description: Log member role additions/removals.

configFields.label: Role Changes Channel
configFields.description: Override for role changes. Empty uses the Member Events channel.

configFields.label: Ignored Channel IDs
configFields.description: Channel IDs whose message events are not logged.
